learnings: Tool errors (API failures, parse errors) should be clearly distinguished from security findings in verdict aggregation - they should not trigger 'inconclusive' when other models successfully reviewed the same files
When multiple models review the same package, coverage gaps in one model should be filled by successful reviews from other models rather than defaulting to 'inconclusive'
Advisory reports should be excluded from verdict calculation entirely to avoid confusion about disagreement sources
